first_step_test: One low teardrop body with a pointed snout and one attached round ear immediately sets the side-view toy-mouse silhouette in its final position.

source.notes: Approved panels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 6 from one six-panel handmade felt-tip-marker contact sheet. Source panel 5 remains private because its feet-only color pass was redundant.

final_elements.name: teardrop mouse body and snout
final_elements.description: One low left-facing teardrop body ending in a small pointed snout.

final_elements.name: round ear
final_elements.description: One round visible ear attached near the upper-front body with one inner-ear curve.

final_elements.name: two toy feet
final_elements.description: Exactly two small rounded feet attached beneath the body, each with two short seam marks.

final_elements.name: curled tail
final_elements.description: One thin tail attached at the rear and curled upward into one open loop.

final_elements.name: wind-up key assembly
final_elements.description: One short shaft attached to the upper rear body, one small collar, and exactly two oval key lobes.

final_elements.name: profile face and three whiskers
final_elements.description: One sleepy crescent eye, one dark triangular nose, one crooked smile, and exactly three whiskers from the visible cheek.

final_elements.name: three body spots
final_elements.description: Exactly three small round decorative spots inside the established body.

frames.visible_job: Draws one low teardrop body with a pointed snout and one attached round ear.
frames.instruction: Draw one low teardrop body pointing left, keeping the rear broad and the snout small. Attach one round ear near the upper front and add one curved inner-ear line.

frames.step_name: Add the feet and curled tail
frames.visible_job: Adds two attached toy feet with seam marks and one rear tail curled into an open loop.
frames.instruction: Attach exactly two rounded feet beneath the body and add two short seam marks inside each one. From the rear point, pull one thin tail upward and curl it into one open loop.

frames.visible_job: Adds one fixed rear shaft, collar, and two oval key lobes without moving the tail.
frames.instruction: From the upper rear body, draw one short key shaft and a small collar where it attaches. Cap the shaft with exactly two sideways oval lobes, leaving a narrow gap between the key and the curled tail.

frames.visible_job: Adds one crescent eye, nose, crooked smile, three cheek whiskers, and three body spots.
frames.instruction: Add one sleepy crescent eye, one dark triangular nose, and a tiny crooked smile. Pull exactly three whiskers back from the visible cheek, then place exactly three small round spots across the rear body.

final_step.visible_job: Fills established shapes with coral, mustard, and teal, then adds two small highlights and one broken navy shadow accent.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established body coral, inner ear and key mustard, and both feet plus all three spots teal. Leave exactly two small body highlights open and add one broken deep-navy shadow beneath the feet; keep the black outline visible and add no new structural contours.
adds: bright marker color on established regions

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains one low closed teardrop body in its final left-facing position plus one attached round ear and inner curve. Those two connected forms are immediately copyable and reserve clear room below for feet and behind for the tail and key.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Compared the five selected saved crops pairwise. The body, ear, two feet with four seam marks, open tail curl, fixed key collar and two lobes, crescent eye, nose, crooked smile, three whiskers, and three spots keep identical anchors; the finish adds only marker color, two small highlights, and a broken shadow accent.
